name: 32671-specdecode-8b-1gpu
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (target) + yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B (draft head). The target is the ungated mirror of the gated `meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct` -- same weights, a mirror and not a substitution.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1. One in-process vLLM engine on one card.
architecture: Target: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB. Draft: EAGLE3 head, one decoder layer over hidden 4096, its own lm_head, max_position_embeddings 2048 and no rope scaling, 0.85 GB; its config says float16 but it loads in the target's bf16.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=4, bounded at 480 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, warmup the first 20% by completion. `max-num-seqs: 32` bounds how far the operating point may walk.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: exactly 1536 prompt tokens and exactly 384 output tokens on every request (min == max == mean on both, so the distribution is a point mass). `request_format: plain` sends the prompt as a raw completion with no chat template; guidellm turns `output_tokens` into max_tokens=384 with ignore_eos. Greedy (temperature 0.0), static seed 32671. 1536 + 384 = 1920 positions at the end of the longest request, under the draft head's 2048-position ceiling.
purpose: An eight-billion-parameter writing assistant with a draft model, serving four concurrent users fixed long prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# Declared serving configuration. The load is not in this file; it is scenario.json's `streams`.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct

speculative-config: {"method": "eagle3", "model": "yuhuili/EAGLE3-LLaMA3.1-Instruct-8B", "num_speculative_tokens": 3}

# LOAD-BEARING. An H100 does not choose Triton attention by itself; without this line the engine
# serves a different backend, succeeds, and reports a plausible number for a setup nobody asked
# for. The spelling is the engine's own `AttentionBackendEnum` member name.
attention-backend: TRITON_ATTN

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: bfloat16

# A ceiling set by the draft head, which declares max_position_embeddings 2048 and no rope
# scaling. The workload is sized under it: 1536 prompt + 384 output = 1920 positions.
max-model-len: 2048

max-num-seqs: 32

enable-prefix-caching: false

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
